description: Provision a Google Cloud Certificatemanager CertificateManagerCertificate via Config Connector. Fields mirror the certificatemanager.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 CertificateManagerCertificate spec.

description.description: A human-readable description of the resource.

location.description: Immutable. The Certificate Manager location. If not specified, "global" is used.

managed.description: Immutable. Configuration and state of a Managed Certificate. Certificate Manager provisions and renews Managed Certificates automatically, for as long as it's authorized to do so.

authorizationAttemptInfo.description: Detailed state of the latest authorization attempt for each domain specified for this Managed Certificate.

details.description: Human readable explanation for reaching the state. Provided to help address the configuration issues. Not guaranteed to be stable. For programmatic access use 'failure_reason' field.

domain.description: Domain name of the authorization attempt.

failureReason.description: Reason for failure of the authorization attempt for the domain.

state.description: State of the domain for managed certificate issuance.

dnsAuthorizationsRefs.description: Immutable. Authorizations that will be used for performing domain authorization. Either issuanceConfig or dnsAuthorizations should be specified, but not both.

items.description: CertificateManagerDNSAuthorizationRef is a reference to a GCP CertificateManagerDNSAuthorization. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed CertificateManagerDNSAuthorization resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/dnsAuthorizations/{{dnsAuthorizationID}}".

name.description: The name of a CertificateManagerDNSAuthorization resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a CertificateManagerDNSAuthorization resource.

domains.description: Immutable. The domains for which a managed SSL certificate will be generated. Wildcard domains are only supported with DNS challenge resolution.

issuanceConfigRef.description:
Only the `external` field is supported to configure the reference.

Immutable. The resource name for a CertificateIssuanceConfig used to configure private PKI certificates in the format projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/certificateIssuanceConfigs/{{name}}.
If this field is not set, the certificates will instead be publicly signed as documented at https://cloud.google.com/load-balancing/docs/ssl-certificates/google-managed-certs#caa.
Either issuanceConfig or dnsAuthorizations should be specified, but not both. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed CertificateManagerCertificateIssuanceConfig resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/certificateIssuanceConfigs/{{certificateIssuanceConfigID}}".

provisioningIssue.description: Information about issues with provisioning this Managed Certificate.

details.description: Human readable explanation about the issue. Provided to help address the configuration issues. Not guaranteed to be stable. For programmatic access use 'reason' field.

state.description: A state of this Managed Certificate.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

scope.description:
Immutable. The scope of the certificate.

DEFAULT: Certificates with default scope are served from core Google data centers.
If unsure, choose this option.

EDGE_CACHE: Certificates with scope EDGE_CACHE are special-purposed certificates,
served from non-core Google data centers.

ALL_REGIONS: Certificates with ALL_REGIONS scope are served from all GCP regions (You can only use ALL_REGIONS with global certs).
see https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/regions-zones.

selfManaged.description: Immutable. Certificate data for a SelfManaged Certificate. SelfManaged Certificates are uploaded by the user. Updating such certificates before they expire remains the user's responsibility.

certificatePem.description:
DEPRECATED. `certificate_pem` is deprecated. Use `pem_certificate` instead. Immutable. The certificate chain in PEM-encoded form.

Leaf certificate comes first, followed by intermediate ones if any.
